calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 3
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT category
FROM dim_product
WHERE category LIKE '%Paint%' OR category LIKE '%Decorating%'
ORDER BY category;

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_eur,
    COUNT(*) AS stock_snapshots_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.store_key) AS stores_represented,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.product_key) AS products_represented
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE 
    dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 3;

SELECT 
    dd.fiscal_week,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshot_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.store_key) AS stores,
    AVG(fsw.closing_value) AS avg_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE 
    dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_week
ORDER BY dd.fiscal_week;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_snapshots,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.store_key) AS total_stores,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.product_key) AS total_products,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) AS total_value_eur,
    MIN(fsw.closing_value) AS min_value,
    MAX(fsw.closing_value) AS max_value,
    COUNT(fsw.closing_value) AS non_null_values
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE 
    dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 3;

SELECT 
    fsw.week_ending_date,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) AS weekly_total_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE 
    dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND fsw.week_ending_date >= '2026-06-29'
    AND fsw.week_ending_date <= '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
ORDER BY fsw.week_ending_date;

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(weekly_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_eur
FROM (
    SELECT 
        fsw.week_ending_date,
        SUM(fsw.closing_value) AS weekly_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fsw
    INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
    WHERE 
        dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
        AND fsw.week_ending_date >= '2026-06-29'
        AND fsw.week_ending_date <= '2026-08-02'
    GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
) AS weekly_totals;
